verified_facts: determined-boundary surveys may use measurements from permanent features
determined-boundary surveys may use OS National Grid coordinates
coordinate use requires specialist surveying equipment
measurement-based plans require measurements accurate to plus or minus 10mm
measurements must be horizontal rather than along a slope
measurements must be taken from at least two defined permanent physical features
the preferred determined-boundary plan scale is no smaller than 1:200
these requirements apply only to the determined-boundary evidence route
quality_effect: Records the actual precision requirements for determined-boundary evidence without applying them to general-boundary candidates.
